findings.one_line: The promised all-procedure frontier N^*(d,alpha,lambda) on the separated restricted-ANM envelope is replaced by a matched upper/lower frontier only for the strict Hermite-chart subclass M_d^H(lambda); the full class receives only a lower bound.

This negative theorem refutes a protocol introduced in the note, not a named published estimator or workflow (with bibkey and claimed guarantee), so it lacks the required theorem-level target and positioning for a counterexample contribution.

Positioning does not give a relevance/comparison sentence for every cited item (including the listed Stone, Wainwright, Tsybakov, and Gaussian-kernel sources), so the rate claim's literature review is not yet targeted and complete under the stated citation standard.
